        assert dim >= -x.ndim and dim < x.ndim, "Invalid dim"
        dim = dim % x.ndim
        M = 1
        N = x.shape[dim]
        for i in range(dim):
            M *= x.shape[i]
        inp = x.contiguous()
        if dtype is None:
            dtype = x.dtype
        out = torch.empty_like(inp, dtype=dtype)
        K = inp.numel() // M // N

        grid = lambda meta: (

                N,
                K,
            )
        return in_grad, None, None

    return LogSoftmax.apply(x, dim, dtype)
